sentences.en: The Hidden Brain team has felt a range of emotions as we've watched the spread of coronavirus.
sentences.zh: Hidden Brain 团队在目睹新冠病毒传播的过程中，感受到了各种各样的情绪。

sentences.en: Like you, we've had moments of frustration and anxiety and fear.
sentences.zh: 和你们一样，我们也曾感到沮丧、焦虑和恐惧。

sentences.en: Such emotions can play a big role in our response to a disease outbreak.
sentences.zh: 这些情绪在我们应对疾病爆发时起着重要作用。

sentences.en: Another key factor, our ability to trust the guidance of public health experts.
sentences.zh: 另一个关键因素是，我们是否有能力信任公共卫生专家的指导。

sentences.en: We first explored this idea several years ago while working on an episode about an Ebola outbreak in Africa.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我们在制作一期关于非洲埃博拉疫情的节目时，首次探讨了这个想法。

sentences.en: We thought we'd bring you that story today in the hopes that it may remind us that expertise combined with authentic human connection can achieve a lot during times of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我们想今天把那个故事带给你们，希望它能提醒我们：在不确定的时期，专业知识与真诚的人际联系相结合，可以成就很多事情。

sentences.en: In 1950, before he directed the film On the Waterfront, Elia Kazan made another dramatic thriller, a movie called Panic in the Streets.
sentences.zh: 1950年，在执导电影《码头风云》之前，Elia Kazan 拍摄了另一部剧情惊悚片，名为《街头恐慌》。

sentences.en: There's a reason you probably haven't heard of it.
sentences.zh: 你可能没听说过这部电影是有原因的。
它算不上什么伟大的电影。

sentences.en: Here with recorded is the story of a silent, savage menace.
sentences.zh: 这里记录的是一个无声而野蛮的威胁的故事。

sentences.en: The events, incidents, and emotions of the people who were a part of it, who found time running out as they looked into the face of mortal peril.
sentences.zh: 这是关于那些身处其中的人们所经历的事件、遭遇和情绪，当他们面对死亡的威胁时，发现时间所剩无几。

sentences.en: The film tells the fictional story of a murder in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个发生在纽奥良的虚构谋杀案。

sentences.en: When the police investigate, they find the victim suffered from a deadly infectious disease, a version of the plague.
sentences.zh: 当警察调查时，他们发现受害者患有一种致命的传染病，一种鼠疫。

sentences.en: Public health officials believe the killers may have contracted the disease as they carried the victim's body away.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员认为，凶手在搬运受害者尸体时可能已经感染了这种疾病。

sentences.en: What follows is a race to track down the criminals and halt an epidemic, a collision of law enforcement and public health.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一场追踪罪犯并阻止疫情蔓延的竞赛，是执法部门与公共卫生部门的碰撞。

sentences.en: If the killer is incubating humanic plague, he can start spreading it within 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 如果凶手正处于鼠疫潜伏期，他可以在48小时内开始传播病毒。

sentences.en: Shortly after that, you'll have the makings of an epidemic.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，疫情就会形成。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we have a story where life imitates art.
sentences.zh: 今天节目里，我们要讲一个生活模仿艺术的故事。

sentences.en: It's a story about disease and panic, but it's also a story about psychology.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于疾病和恐慌的故事，但它也是一个关于心理学的故事。

sentences.en: To control an epidemic takes more than medical skill.
sentences.zh: 控制疫情需要的不仅仅是医疗技术。

sentences.en: It requires an understanding of human behavior and the forces that drive people to act in certain ways.
sentences.zh: 它需要对人类行为以及驱动人们以特定方式行事的各种力量有深刻的理解。

sentences.en: Our story starts in Monrovia, the capital of Liberia.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事始于利比里亚首都蒙罗维亚。

sentences.en: A deadly crisis was sparking fear.
sentences.zh: 一场致命的危机正在引发恐慌。

sentences.en: Newst reports were filled with dramatic language and catastrophic warnings.
sentences.zh: 新闻报道中充斥着戏剧性的语言和灾难性的警告。

sentences.en: An Ebola breakout in West Africa is, quote, totally out of control.
sentences.zh: 西非的埃博拉疫情，引用原话，已经“完全失控”。

sentences.en: The world's deadliest outbreak of Ebola.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最致命的埃博拉疫情。

sentences.en: Highly infectious, quick to kill, with no vaccine and no cure.
sentences.zh: 传染性极强，致死迅速，且没有疫苗，没有特效药。

sentences.en: The Ebola outbreak reached its peak in the fall of 2014.
sentences.zh: 埃博拉疫情在2014年秋季达到顶峰。

sentences.en: By the end of the year, it was subsiding.
sentences.zh: 到年底时，疫情正在消退。

sentences.en: But then, in early 2015, in a poor part of Monrovia, there was a new outbreak, or cluster.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在2015年初，蒙罗维亚的一个贫困地区出现了新的疫情或聚集性病例。

sentences.en: And it led to the complex case we're focusing on today.
sentences.zh: 这引出了我们今天重点关注的复杂案例。

sentences.en: I got a call from someone who said,
sentences.zh: 我接到一个人的电话，他说：

sentences.en: if your passport isn't in my office in the next two hours, you won't make your flight to Liberia.
sentences.zh: “如果你的护照在接下来的两个小时内没送到我的办公室，你就赶不上飞往利比里亚的航班了。”

sentences.en: Athalia Christie is an epidemiologist with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or CDC.
sentences.zh: Athalia Christie 是美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）的一名流行病学家。

sentences.en: She flew to Monrovia to help track and stop the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 她飞往蒙罗维亚，协助追踪并阻止疫情蔓延。

sentences.en: Lots of CDC officials joined her, like Frank Mahoney.
sentences.zh: 许多 CDC 的官员也加入了她的行列，比如 Frank Mahoney。

sentences.en: You could drive to the city and see people that were being left out on the street, you know, for people to come pick them up.
sentences.zh: 你开车进城，能看到人们被留在街上，你知道，等着有人来接他们。

sentences.en: Frank and Athalia told me how the case we're following today started.
sentences.zh: Frank 和 Athalia 向我讲述了我们今天追踪的这个案例是如何开始的。

sentences.en: Police in Monrovia discovered a body in a warehouse.
sentences.zh: 蒙罗维亚警方在一个仓库里发现了一具尸体。

sentences.en: A young man, dead, with multiple stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻男子，已经死亡，身上有多处刀伤。
警方接到报案赶到现场。

sentences.en: A swab was taken, as mandated by the official policy, that any dead body be swabbed.
sentences.zh: 按照官方规定，所有死者尸体都必须进行拭子采样，于是他们采集了样本。

sentences.en: So even though the police who arrived there initially thought they were investigating a murder,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管最初赶到现场的警察以为他们在调查一起谋杀案，

sentences.en: they did follow the procedures and have the body swabbed, at which point we were alerted because the test came back positive.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实遵循了程序并对尸体进行了采样，随后测试结果呈阳性，我们便接到了警报。

sentences.en: Once police identified the youth, they quickly realized they had a major problem on their hands.
sentences.zh: 一旦警察确认了这名年轻人的身份，他们很快意识到自己面临一个大麻烦。

sentences.en: It turned out the young man was actually part of a large street gang.
sentences.zh: 原来这名年轻人实际上是一个大型街头帮派的成员。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like a gang.
One of them, for whatever reason, he got stabbed by other members of the group.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人，不知出于什么原因，被团伙里的其他人捅伤了。

sentences.en: As we understand it, there was a knife fight, and we're not quite sure how it happened, but the friends turned on him.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，当时发生了一场刀战，我们不太确定具体是怎么发生的，但他的朋友们对他下了毒手。

sentences.en: Just to review, a young man contracts Ebola, he gets in a fight, and it's stabbed repeatedly by fellow members of his gang.
sentences.zh: 回顾一下：一名年轻人感染了埃博拉，他卷入了一场斗殴，并被帮派成员多次捅伤。
记住，埃博拉具有高度传染性。

sentences.en: Come into contact with an infected person's sweat or blood, and you could fall sick too.
sentences.zh: 接触感染者的汗液或血液，你也可能生病。

sentences.en: The gang had as many as 35 members.
Each had connections far and wide across the city.
sentences.zh: 每个人在城里都有广泛的人际关系。

sentences.en: And just like in that movie, Panic in the Streets, public health officials needed to quickly stop the outbreak from spreading.
sentences.zh: 就像电影《街头恐慌》里一样，公共卫生官员需要迅速阻止疫情蔓延。

sentences.en: They needed to try and find every person who could have come into contact with the young man.
sentences.zh: 他们需要尝试找到每一个可能与这名年轻人有过接触的人。

sentences.en: It's a process called contact tracing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个被称为“接触者追踪”的过程。

sentences.en: If you try to imagine constructing the last three weeks of your life
sentences.zh: 如果你试着回想自己过去三周的生活，

sentences.en: and determining every single person that you came into contact with,
sentences.zh: 并确定你接触过的每一个人，

sentences.en: whether it was casual contact or a family member who you saw every day,
sentences.zh: 无论是偶然接触，还是每天见面的家人，

sentences.en: So we interview people multiple times,
sentences.zh: 所以我们多次采访人们，

sentences.en: and we also talk to their family members and their friends
sentences.zh: 我们也与他们的家人和朋友交谈，

sentences.en: to try to determine everyone who might have had any contact with this person
sentences.zh: 试图确定在他们可能具有传染性的期间，

sentences.en: during the time that they could have been infectious.
sentences.zh: 所有可能与此人有过任何接触的人。

sentences.en: Etheli and Frank knew the young man who died had sought medical treatment for his stab wounds,
sentences.zh: Athalia 和 Frank 知道，死去的年轻人曾因刀伤寻求过医疗救治，

sentences.en: had a health care worker suture the young man's wounds and come into contact with his blood.
sentences.zh: 有一名医护人员为他缝合了伤口，并接触到了他的血液。

sentences.en: Etheli visited a lot of clinics trying to track down facilities the young man may have visited.
sentences.zh: Athalia 走访了许多诊所，试图追踪这名年轻人可能去过的医疗机构。

sentences.en: She paged through logbooks of patient names with no luck.
sentences.zh: 她翻阅了患者名单的登记簿，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Then she got to one clinic.
sentences.zh: 然后她来到了一家诊所。

sentences.en: And I took this big, dusty logbook, and I opened it up,
sentences.zh: 我拿起那本厚厚的、布满灰尘的登记簿，翻开它，

sentences.en: and literally the page I opened it to, there's maybe 30 names to a page,
sentences.zh: 我翻到的那一页，一页大约有30个名字，

sentences.en: and I read down them, and there he was at the bottom of the first page.
sentences.zh: 我往下读，就在第一页的底部，找到了他。

sentences.en: A health care worker at this clinic had sutured the young man's knife wounds.
sentences.zh: 这家诊所的一名医护人员为这名年轻人缝合了刀伤。

sentences.en: Etheli knew what she had to do.
sentences.zh: Athalia 知道她必须做什么。

sentences.en: The most difficult part of these investigations come when you need to tell the clinicians
sentences.zh: 这些调查中最困难的部分，就是当你需要告诉临床医生，

sentences.en: and all of the staff who work in these health care facilities
sentences.zh: 以及在这些医疗机构工作的所有员工，

sentences.en: that someone with Ebola entered the facility.
sentences.zh: 说有一个感染埃博拉的人进入了该设施时。

sentences.en: And I remember how nervous the individual was when I told him that the person he sutured
sentences.zh: 我记得当我告诉那个人，他缝合的那个人当时埃博拉检测呈阳性时，他有多紧张。

sentences.en: had been positive for Ebola at the time.
sentences.zh: 很难想象他当时经历了什么。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine what he was going through.
sentences.zh: 你还记得你告诉了他什么，以及他说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Can you recall what you told him and what he said?
sentences.zh: 我们站在走廊里，我告诉他，告诉任何人这件事都没有简单的方法。

sentences.en: We were standing in the hallway, and I told him that there's no easy way to tell anybody this.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是非常客观地告诉了他，

sentences.en: And so we just told him very matter-of-factly
sentences.zh: 我们需要与他保持日常联系和监测，

sentences.en: and that we needed to maintain daily contact and monitoring with him
sentences.zh: 一旦出现症状就立即来接受治疗。

sentences.en: coming in for treatment the moment that you have symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 我之所以记得这么清楚，是因为他并没有这样做。

sentences.en: And the reason I remember this so clearly is that he didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 他非常不情愿去埃博拉治疗中心。

sentences.en: He was very reluctant to go to an Ebola treatment unit.
sentences.zh: 这名医护人员拒绝被隔离。

sentences.en: The health care worker refused to be quarantined.
sentences.zh: 他坚持说他在包扎伤口时遵循了所有的安全程序。

sentences.en: He insisted he'd followed all safety procedures as he bandaged the young man's wounds.
sentences.zh: 他告诉 Athalia，如果他开始出现任何症状，他会联系他们。

sentences.en: He told Etheli he'd get in touch if he started to have any symptoMs.
sentences.zh: Athalia 知道这名医护人员拒绝去埃博拉治疗中心是有原因的。

sentences.en: Etheli knew there was a reason the health care worker had refused to come into an Ebola treatment unit.
sentences.zh: 这与对系统缺乏信任有关。

sentences.en: It had to do with a lack of trust in the system.
sentences.zh: 事实上，Athalia 和 Frank 看到的越多，

sentences.en: In fact, the more Etheli and Frank saw,
sentences.zh: 他们就越意识到，埃博拉并不是他们在蒙罗维亚对抗的唯一敌人。

sentences.en: the more they realized that Ebola wasn't the only enemy they were fighting in Monrovia.
sentences.zh: 他们正在应对一场“不信任”的流行病。

sentences.en: They were dealing with an epidemic of mistruSt.
sentences.zh: 在经历了长期的内战和腐败之后，

sentences.en: After a long history of civil war and corruption,
sentences.zh: 利比里亚的许多人根本不信任政府或国际组织。

sentences.en: a lot of people in Liberia simply didn't trust the government or international organizations.
sentences.zh: 当埃博拉爆发时，政府的初步反应是试图通过强制手段来控制它，

sentences.en: When Ebola broke out, the government's first response was to try and control it using coercion,

sentences.zh: 政府曾尝试过强制隔离，

sentences.en: The government had attempted involuntary quarantine,
sentences.zh: 他们在蒙罗维亚的贫民窟有过非常糟糕的经历。

sentences.en: and they had a really bad experience in the slums of Monrovia.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论过，你知道，这是一种可行的策略吗？

sentences.en: And so we talked about, you know, is this a viable strategy?
sentences.zh: 我们都同意，不，我们不能使用强制隔离。

sentences.en: And we all agreed, no, we can't use involuntary quarantine.
sentences.zh: 这不是能建立社区信任的事情。

sentences.en: This is not something that's going to build trust in the community.
sentences.zh: 这不是管理疫情的方法。

sentences.en: It's not a way to manage the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 人们还担心，如果他们真的被隔离，就永远出不来了。

sentences.en: People also worried that if they did go into quarantine, they would never come out.
sentences.zh: Athalia 指出了利比里亚最大的埃博拉治疗中心之一的建设情况。

sentences.en: Etheli pointed to the construction of one of the largest Ebola treatment units in Liberia.
sentences.zh: 当时情况混乱且困难，他们建好了所有设施，却忘了留出口。

sentences.en: And it was chaotic and difficult, and they built it all, and they forgot to put an exit in.
sentences.zh: 他们没有建出口，因为那时我们没考虑过幸存者的问题。

sentences.en: They didn't build an exit because we weren't thinking about survivors at that time.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是几个月后的事了，

sentences.en: And although this was many months later,
sentences.zh: 许多人理所当然地认为，去埃博拉治疗中心，

sentences.en: many people, understandably so, thought that going to an Ebola treatment unit
meant that you would not come home.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员知道，处理不信任问题，

sentences.en: Dealing with mistrust, the public health officials knew,
sentences.zh: 是他们开始追踪这个复杂案例所有线索的核心。

sentences.en: was central as they began to trace all the leads of this complex case.
sentences.zh: 当 Athalia 一直在追踪那名医护人员时，

sentences.en: As Athalia had been tracking down the health care worker,
sentences.zh: Frank 一直在调查案件的另一条线索，

sentences.en: Frank had been pursuing a different strand of the investigation,
sentences.zh: 追踪那名年轻人的帮派成员。

sentences.en: tracking down the members of the young man's gang.
sentences.zh: 这是一个与政府关系不太好的社区。

sentences.en: This was a community that was not on the best terms with the government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们对政府非常怀疑。

sentences.en: You know, they were very suspicious of the government.
sentences.zh: 所以进入这个社区去拼凑故事的所有碎片，确实是一项建立信任的练习。

sentences.en: So it really is a trust-building exercise to go into this community
sentences.zh: 很快，Frank 和 Athalia 就意识到他们力不从心了。

sentences.en: to piece together all these pieces of the story.
Very quickly, Frank and Athalia realized they were in over their heads.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们进行调查时，我和这位利比里亚人一起去了。
一位出色的利比里亚流行病学家。

sentences.en: So when we did the investigation, I went with this Liberian.
sentences.zh: 一个叫 Musaka Fala 的人。
作为利比里亚人，Musaka Fala 对事情的理解远胜于美国人。
他也亲身了解埃博拉的恐怖。

sentences.en: As a Liberian, Musaka Fala understood things far better than the Americans.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病夺走了他姐姐的生命。

sentences.en: He also understood the horrors of Ebola firsthand.
sentences.zh: Musaka 的首要任务是帮助追踪帮派里的年轻人。

sentences.en: The disease had killed his sister.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他们并不难找。

sentences.en: Musaka's first order of business was to help track down the young men in the gang.
Surprisingly, they weren't hard to find.
sentences.zh: 害怕警察（警察仍在将此案作为凶杀案调查）会因为他们在刀战中的角色而逮捕他们。

sentences.en: Scared that the police, who were still investigating the case as a homicide,
would arrest them for their role in the knife fight.
The police wanted to go in.
However, if we allowed the police to go in,
sentences.zh: 然而，如果我们允许警察进入，
帮派分子就会全部逃跑，

sentences.en: and we have pretty close to 35 young men
sentences.zh: 而且我们还有近35名年轻人，

sentences.en: who were all hard-risk contact on the loose.
sentences.zh: 他们都是高风险接触者，正逍遥法外。

sentences.en: This is similar to what happened in panic in the streets.
sentences.zh: 这和《街头恐慌》里发生的情况很像。

sentences.en: Wait a minute, Nev, wait a minute.
Frank suggested that there should be no arreSt.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克建议不要进行逮捕。

sentences.en: Musaka says Frank sat down with the police.
sentences.zh: 穆萨卡说弗兰克和警方坐下来谈过。

sentences.en: He told them that any investigation of the murder
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，任何针对谋杀案的调查

sentences.en: would send gang members into hiding
sentences.zh: 都会让帮派成员躲起来，
并可能导致埃博拉病毒进一步传播。

sentences.en: They should allow the Ebola team to go in and negotiate
sentences.zh: 他们应该允许埃博拉防控小组进入并进行谈判，

sentences.en: so that we can have the contact.
sentences.zh: 这样我们才能接触到那些人。

sentences.en: And the police withdrew their arreSt.
And that's how we went in to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样进去进行谈判的。
每个人都告诉我们，正是这一点，

sentences.en: is what allowed public health officials
to start talking to the young men in the gang.
sentences.zh: 得以开始与帮派中的年轻人对话。

sentences.en: public health officials had tracked down
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员追踪到了

sentences.en: the health care worker who treated the young man
sentences.zh: 那位治疗过年轻人的医护人员，

sentences.en: and identified all the people they could tell
sentences.zh: 并确定了所有他们能确认的
